chunks: This Qur'an is not such (a writ) as could be composed by anyone but God. It confirms what has been revealed before, and is an exposition of (Heaven's) law. Without any doubt it's from the Lord of all the worlds.
ai.seo_question: What is the divine origin and purpose of the Qur'an according to Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Qur'an's role as the ultimate criterion (Furqan) that authenticates prior revelations while providing their detailed interpretation (Tafsir). It highlights the continuity of divine guidance, affirming that the Qur'an is not a human invention but the precise, doubt-free word of the Lord of the Worlds, serving as the final and complete exposition of the original Book.
